description: This file defines a PHP class `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateCampaignLogEntryButton` which extends `SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton`. The class provides methods to generate a button in a subpanel UI for creating campaign log entries in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including access control checks, configuration of popup request data, and rendering HTML button markup.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateCampaignLogEntryButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a button in a subpanel that allows creating a campaign log entry, with access control and popup configuration.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns a unique widget ID, appending '_select_button' suffix.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML code for the button, handling access rights, configuring popup request data, and embedding necessary JavaScript for opening a popup window with appropriate parameters.
